items.question: Do I need to know how to code?
items.answer: No. Stack32 is built for non-technical users. You describe what you need in plain language and Stack32 handles everything else.

items.question: What can my agent actually do?
items.answer: Agents can research the web, read your documents, analyze information and produce structured answers, tables and reports.

items.question: How fast can I get a working agent?
items.answer: A first working version is typically ready in under a minute, and most agents reach a satisfying result within four to five prompts.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before building your first agent.

items.question: Do I need to know how to code?
items.answer: No. Stack32 is designed for non-technical users. You describe what you need in plain language and Stack32 builds, tests and runs the agent for you.

items.question: Is this like n8n, Make or Zapier?
items.answer: No. There are no nodes, no workflows and no drag-and-drop canvas. You talk to a builder, and you get a working agent you can immediately chat with.

items.question: What can my agent do?
items.answer: Agents can search the web, read the documents you connect, analyze information, do calculations and produce structured answers such as reports and tables.

items.question: How long does it take to create an agent?
items.answer: A first working version typically appears in under a minute. Most agents reach a satisfying result within four to five prompts.

items.question: Can I modify an agent after creating it?
items.answer: Yes — that's the core of Stack32. Ask for changes in the Build view and Stack32 applies them, retests your agent and keeps every previous version.

items.question: What languages does the interface support?
items.answer: English and French today. The architecture is ready for more languages.

items.question: How does billing work?
items.answer: Stack32 uses a simple monthly subscription handled securely by Whop. You can cancel anytime.

items.question: Who is behind Stack32?
items.answer: Stack32 is a Synko product, operated by Zeldia, a company registered in France.
